finder.title: 1. Find verified calls in under 3 clicks
finder.body: Filter real opportunities by country, category, or modality. Every item displays its verification date and official source.

hybridStatus.title: 2. Real Hybrid AI awareness
hybridStatus.body: See at a glance whether Chrome on-device AI (Gemini Nano) is ready offline or when Firebase Cloud AI will be used only with your consent.

detailCard.title: 3. Open any opportunity for Match + AI
detailCard.body: Compare your profile transparently (Match, Mismatch, Needs Confirmation, Unknown) and ask Hybrid AI to explain requirements in plain language.

myRouteNav.title: 4. Keep focus in My Route
myRouteNav.body: Save opportunities in one click, set 1 clear goal, and organize up to 3 active next steps stored privately on your device.

explore.heroTitle: Find real opportunities and check if you qualify in minutes.
explore.heroDescription: Check requirements against your profile in minutes — no sign-up. Verified calls only.
explore.searchPlaceholder: e.g., scholarship, cybersecurity, Python, SENA, PRONABEC…
explore.emptyBody: Try clearing a filter, switching country/international scope, or showing closed calls for reference.
explore.errorTitle: Could not display the opportunity catalog
explore.errorBody: Something interrupted loading the catalog view. Your saved data remains safe on this device.

fit.label: Your fit:
fit.empty: Add a few profile details to see how you match.

PREFER_ON_DEVICE.label: Prefer On-Device (Hybrid Default)
PREFER_ON_DEVICE.description: Runs locally via Chrome Gemini Nano when ready; falls back to Firebase Cloud Gemini only if consented.

ONLY_ON_DEVICE.label: Strict On-Device Only
ONLY_ON_DEVICE.description: Zero cloud transmission. Blocks cloud fallback even if local model is unavailable.

PREFER_IN_CLOUD.label: Prefer Cloud (Fallback Local)
PREFER_IN_CLOUD.description: Uses Firebase Cloud Gemini first (with your consent) and falls back locally on network errors.

ONLY_IN_CLOUD.label: Cloud Only (Firebase AI Logic)
ONLY_IN_CLOUD.description: Always uses cloud Gemini via Firebase AI Logic with App Check protection.

consent.bannerBody: To use cloud inference ({{reason}}), UMBRAL sends ONLY the selected opportunity's verified text and your question to Google Firebase AI Logic (Gemini API). Your saved route tasks, identity numbers, and private history are never sent.
consent.grant: Allow Firebase Cloud AI for this browser
consent.grantedStatus: Cloud consent granted (revocable anytime in Settings)
consent.notGrantedStatus: Local-only default · No data leaves browser without consent

panel.compareSelectLabel: Optionally compare against another verified opportunity
panel.followUpPlaceholder: Ask a follow-up or compare requirements across these two calls…
panel.offlineChatHint: Cloud follow-up is unavailable while offline. Reconnect to ask Firebase Cloud AI.

errors.FIREBASE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Firebase Web App configuration is missing in .env ({{details}}). You can still browse verified calls, use deterministic 4-state matching, and manage My Route offline.
errors.ON_DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE: On-device Chrome AI is unavailable on this browser or hardware right now ({{details}}). Switch mode or allow Firebase Cloud AI consent.
errors.APP_CHECK_FAILED: Could not verify App Check / reCAPTCHA protection on this browser or domain ({{details}}). Check content blockers or try again.
errors.CLOUD_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Cloud consent has not been granted yet. Confirm Cloud Consent below or use Strict On-Device mode when Chrome Gemini Nano is ready.
errors.CLOUD_CONSENT_REQUIRED_FOR_FALLBACK: On-device AI is not ready and silent cloud fallback is blocked to protect privacy. Grant Cloud Consent or initialize the local model.
errors.NETWORK_OFFLINE: No internet connection detected for Cloud AI. Wait until online or switch to Strict On-Device when Chrome Gemini Nano is ready.
errors.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The AI request timed out before finishing. Please try again or switch inference modes.
errors.INVALID_AI_OUTPUT: The AI returned malformed output that failed safety validation. Please try again.
errors.AI_SAFETY_OR_QUOTA: The AI request was blocked by quota, rate limits, or safety filters ({{details}}).
errors.AI_EXECUTION_FAILED: Firebase AI Logic could not complete the request ({{details}}).

privacy.heading: Privacy, Transparency & AI Boundaries
privacy.intro: UMBRAL works local-first. Never asks for accounts, IDs, income, or health data.

cards.localFirstTitle: 1. Your data stays on your device
cards.localFirstBody: Your goal, up to 3 steps, saved opportunities, and self-check live in localStorage unless you export or delete them.
cards.onDeviceBody: On Chrome Desktop 139+ with Gemini Nano ready, single-turn breakdowns run locally with zero cloud payload.
cards.cloudBoundaryBody: Firebase Cloud AI runs only after your consent (protected by App Check limited-use tokens), sending only verified dossier text and your question.
cards.honestyBody: We show verification dates, unknown fields, never replace official decisions, and report the true SDK inferenceSource.
